This page is also available as Markdown . Copy On this page Tokenomics $SNS Token $SNS is a community token by .sol holders for .sol holders. It was created to align the future of the Solana Name Service with its most frequent users, so that the .sol community can decide how to support participation, reward builders, and shape their own .sol experience. Distribution and Supply The total supply of $SNS is 10 billion tokens. $SNS distribution is focused on long-term community growth, with the majority of the supply earmarked for the community: 40% of total supply will be claimable by existing .sol domain holders, Solana communities and partners, and users of SNS. 20% of total supply is allocated to future emissions and SNS & Solana communities. 26.25% of total supply is for ecosystem growth. These tokens will be unlocked linearly over 4 years starting from TGE. 5% of total supply is for liquidity provision. Finally, 8.75% of total supply is for core contributors, who are locked for a total of 4 years (12-month cliff followed by 3 year linear unlock) starting from TGE. The $SNS Whitepaper contains more infromation on the tokenomics. CA: SNS8DJbHc34nKySHVhLGMUUE72ho6igvJaxtq9T3cX3 FAQs $SNS token What is the $SNS token? $SNS is a community token by .sol holders for .sol holders. It was created to align the future of the Solana Name Service with its most frequent users. Rather than being controlled by a small group, $SNS gives the existing and future .sol community a direct stake in how the identity layer of Solana evolves. Why is SNS launching a token? Over the past few years, SNS has gone through major changes—ambitious early plans, tough pivots, a full rebrand and new leadership. Through all of that, one thing became clear: our .sol holders are still here, still building and still believe in this ecosystem. The launch of $SNS reflects that. It’s not just a token—it’s a way to align the future of this project with the .sol domain holders who are the heart of its community. The ones who’ve been using, integrating and repping .sol through everything. What is the total supply of $SNS? 10 billion tokens. How is the supply distributed? 4 billion $SNS tokens (40% of total supply) will be claimable in the SNS Genesis Airdrop and LFG Campaign: 2 billion $SNS tokens (20% of total supply) will be claimable during the Genesis Airdrop: 1.5 billion $SNS tokens will be claimable by ~275,000 wallets that held 1 or more .sol domains as of the Snapshot. 500 million $SNS tokens will be claimable by other Solana communities and partners ($FIDA holders, pyth.sol, monkedao.sol, tipfi.sol, etc.). 2 billion $SNS tokens (20% of total supply) will be claimable by eligible SNS LFG Campaign participants after the conclusion of the LFG Campaign. 2 billion $SNS tokens (20% of total supply) are allocated to future emissions and SNS & Solana communities. 2.625 billion $SNS tokens (26.25% of total supply) for ecosystem growth. 500 million $SNS tokens (5% of total supply) for liquidity provision. 875 million $SNS tokens (8.75% of total supply) for core contributors, subject to a total of 4 years lockup (a 12-month cliff period followed by vesting over 3 years). Is there a vesting schedule? The allocation to core contributors is subject to a total lockup period of four (4) years (a 12-month cliff period followed by linear unlocking over 3 years). The allocation to ecosystem growth is subject to a total lockup period of four (4) years (linear unlocking over 4 years). There were no presales of the $SNS tokens of any kind. Where can I trade $SNS? $SNS will be available on Jupiter and other major Solana DEXs shortly after launch. Listings on centralized exchanges may follow depending on demand. What can I do with $SNS? As the community coin for .sol holders, $SNS was created to better align the future of Solana Name Service with the people who use it most. While its core purpose today is to recognize the contributions of .sol holders, it was designed with long-term flexibility in mind. As such, we are eager to hear from the community on how best you want to use $SNS to support participation, reward builders, and enhance the .sol experience. How will $SNS help grow the Solana Name Service ecosystem? $SNS was created to better align the growth of the Solana Name Service with the builders, creators and .sol holders who believe in it. Over time, we’re exploring ways for $SNS to help support community initiatives and the expansion of the .sol ecosystem, driven by its community. Our focus is on building opportunities that reward real participation and contribution. Will $SNS be used to pay for domain names? Will $SNS be used for governance? Are there any future uses for $SNS beyond what’s been shared? $SNS was designed to create new ways for .sol holders to participate in shaping the future of the Solana Name Service. If these and other features are something the community wants to implement, we are ready to explore how to make them possible. Will my .sol domain be tied to $SNS in any way? Owning a .sol domain won’t require $SNS, but we'd love to hear from the community about new features you'd like to introduce. How do I avoid scams or fake tokens? Always double-check token addresses on official SNS channels only at sns.id and on X @sns $SNS Genesis Airdrop Am I eligible for the $SNS Genesis Airdrop? Eligibility for the Genesis Airdrop is based on a combination of historical .sol domain activity and participation in the SNS ecosystem. Check your eligibility here: airdrop.sns.id What factors were used to determine allocations in the Genesis Airdrop? All users who matched the criteria below as of the Snapshot (23:59:59 UTC on April 30, 2025) are eligible to claim $SNS: Held a .sol domain name: Loyal supporters of the SNS community. Set a primary .sol domain: Active users of the SNS protocol. 9, 99, 999, 10k, 100k category holders: High-value and rare domain community members. Top 50 buyers: The highest volume .sol domain name buyers. Solana communities: Other communities and partners on Solana, including but not limited to monkedao.sol and pyth.sol subdomain holders and $FIDA token holders. Active SNS ambassadors: Vetted representatives of SNS. When can I claim my Genesis Airdrop $SNS? The claim for the Genesis Airdrop will open on the 15:00 UTC on May 13, 2025 and will remain open for ninety (90) days. Eligible wallets will be able to claim $SNS until 15:00 UTC on August 11, 2025. Genesis Airdrop $SNS will not be claimable after 15:00 UTC on August 11, 2025. Why can’t my .sol domain be used to check the claim? In some cases, .sol domains may not resolve properly due to the following reasons: The domain is listed for sale and temporarily held in escrow. The domain is managed by a sub-registrar and currently held in escrow. The domain was recently linked to a new wallet address that hasn’t been verified. If you experience issues, we recommend using your Solana wallet address directly to check your airdrop eligibility. Why am I getting an “Access Restricted” window when I try to claim my Genesis Airdrop $SNS? Pursuant to applicable laws, regulations, and internal compliance policies, access to the Genesis Airdrop claims platform is geo-restricted and is not available to individuals or entities located in, incorporated in, or otherwise associated with certain jurisdictions deemed prohibited or high-risk. These jurisdictions include, without limitation: the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, The Democratic Republic of Congo, Eritrea, Iran, Libya, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Yemen, United States of America, Canada, the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Thailand, Cuba, Syria, and the People's Republic of Crimea. Is the $SNS claim safe? Do I need to connect my wallet? Yes, the claim is non-custodial and only requires wallet signing—no approvals or transactions are needed to check your allocation. LFG Campaign What’s the LFG campaign? LFG is our community campaign kicking off after the $SNS Genesis Airdrop. It’s packed with missions, rewards, tutorials, collabs with top Solana projects and ways to level up your role in the ecosystem. Whether you’re new to SNS or a longtime .sol holder, it’s your chance to jump in and build your rep. 20% of the total $SNS supply is set aside just for the LFG campaign. If you missed the initial Genesis Airdrop—or just want to go harder—this is your shot. Complete tasks, rank up and claim your piece of it. How can I participate in the LFG Campaign? You can join the LFG campaign here: sns.id/lfg-campaign We’re rolling out missions, leaderboard events, and surprise rewards you can complete to earn dots. Watch @sns and sns.id for updates and be ready to climb. What are dots? Dots are the points you earn by completing tasks during the LFG campaign. Think of them as your progress tracker — the more dots you collect, the more rewards you unlock. You can earn dots through actions like registering domains, updating your profile, referring friends, or participating in supported Solana ecosystem activities. How is the 10% referral bonus calculated? When you use a referral code, the system lets you earn a +10% bonus on all badge rewards collected. How to generate referral codes? To create a referral code, your wallet must hold at least one .sol domain. Once that requirement is met, just click Generate to get your permanent code. Why can’t I enter someone else’s referral code? You can only enter a referral code before generating your own. Once you've created your code, that option is locked. This helps prevent system abuse, such as referral loops, multi-level schemes, or other malicious behavior. If you enter someone else’s referral code, you’ll earn 1,000 bonus dots. It’s a win-win: you get a 1,000 dot bonus, and the person who referred you earns 10% of the dots you collect. What are the eligibility criteria for badges? Registration Badge Eligibility Criteria Only .sol domain registrations made after May 1, 00:00 UTC are eligible. Stage 1: Domain Collector There are five badge tiers: Bronze, Solver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. The more domains you register, the higher your tier — and the bigger your rewards. Badges are verified automatically. The system checks for updates every 1 minute, so if you just registered a domain, give it a moment for your badge to appear. Stage 1 closed on June 12, 2025. Stage 2: Domain Tycoon There are five milestones that are unlocking based on your cumulative spendings on .sol domain registrations. The more you spend on .sol domains, the larger your multiplier for Dots. The tiers start with the minimum exchange rate of $1 = 100 Dots and go to the maximum exchange rate of $1 = 140 Dots. Each tier increases the exchange rate by +10 Dots per $1. All Stage 1 participants will seamlessly transition to Stage 2 with their complete spending history preserved. Early adopters actually benefit more because their Stage 1 spending counts toward their Stage 2 milestone progression, giving them a head start on achieving higher reward tiers. How do the milestone tiers work exactly? The system uses cumulative tier calculations with a maximum of 5 tiers: you earn 100 Dots per $1 for the first $1000 110 Dots per $1 for the next $500 120 Dots per $1 for the next $500 130 Dots per $1 for the next $500 and finally, 140 Dots per $1 for the remaining $500. Once you reach $2500+ spending, all additional spending earns at the maximum rate of 140 Dots per $1. Check this guide on how to register a .sol domain Identity Badge Eligibility Criteria To earn Identity Badges, complete the following actions on your primary domain profile : Set a primary domain: Successfully set up a primary domain. Set an avatar: Upload a profile image. Connect X (Twitter): Link your X (Twitter) account. Connect Telegram: Link your Telegram account. Check these guides on how to set a primary domain and edit your profile Once you've completed an action, click Verify to check your eligibility. If successful, you'll see Obtained. If not, it will show Not eligible yet. Solana Network Badge Eligibility Criteria Network Badges recognize SNS partners and active supporters of the broader Solana ecosystem. During the LFG campaign, a random snapshot will be taken to verify long-term supporters of each community. You’ll be eligible for network badges if you meet all requirements at the time of the snapshot. Madlads: You held a madlads.sol subdomain and had the Madlads role in the SNS Discord. SMB Gen2: You held a monkedao.sol subdomain and had the SMB Gen2 role in SNS Discord. SMB Gen3: You held a monkedao.sol subdomain and had the SMB Gen3 role in SNS Discord. SOL Staker: You held more than 10 JupSOL, JitoSOL, and/or mSOL and had the SOL Stake role in the SNS Discord. Jupiter: Your wallet address staked more than 5,000 $JUP at the time of the snapshot. Zealy: You had over 1,200 XP on Zealy at the time of the snapshot. Domain Badge Eligibility Criteria Buy a .sol domain: Earn this badge by purchasing a .sol domain directly through the SNS marketplace. Only purchases made after May 1, 00:00 UTC will count. Note: P2P trades, bundle purchases, and category bids do not qualify. Check this guide on how to purchase a .sol domain Digital Primes: You’re eligible if you held a role in SNS Discord from one of the following clubs at the time of the snapshot: 9 Club, 99 Club, 999 Club, or 10K Club. Letter League: You’re eligible if you held a role in SNS Discord from one of the following clubs at the time of the snapshot: 1-letter, 2-letter, or 3-letter. How long will the LFG Campaign last? The LFG Campaign is scheduled to end on August 13, 2025. How does the claim process for the LFG Campaign work? The claim window for the LFG Campaign’s allocation of $SNS is currently anticipated to open on August 21, 2025 and to remain open for a period of 31 days, closing on September 21, 2025. We will inform the community in advance of any delays or changes to this schedule. If the claim portal opening date is delayed, we will extend the claim portal closing date proportionally, such that the claim period will stay 31 days. What are the eligibility criteria for the LFG Campaign claim? Who Qualifies: Any wallet that (1) owns a .sol domain at the time of a snapshot (to be taken on August 13, 2025) and (2) has participated in eligible activities to earn Dots during the LFG Campaign. Any wallets that have earned any Solana Network badges , regardless of .sol domain ownership. Disqualification Criteria include (note: the below list is not exhaustive) : Domains listed on external marketplaces (e.g., Magic Eden, Tensor) are not counted. Subdomains are not eligible. Referral points earned by ineligible wallets will not contribute to referral bonuses for referrers. Examples: You invited someone who earns referral points but does not own a .sol domain. You earned referral Dots but do not own a domain nor have a Solana Network badge. You created multiple wallets to abuse referrals. In such cases, Dots will be removed. Eligibility Cases: Alice owns a .sol domain at the time of the snapshot and actively participated in the LFG Campaign activities. ✅ Eligible Brian owns a .sol domain and, at the time of the snapshot, listed it on the SNS marketplace. ✅ Eligible Cindy holds a Solana Network badge, and owns a .sol domain which is listed on Tensor at the time of the snapshot. ✅ Eligible Elle owns a .sol domain and, at the time of the snapshot, listed it on Magic Eden. Elle does not have a Solana Network badge. ❌ Not eligible Fred invites Gary using his referral link. Gary’s wallet is later flagged as ineligible. Gary’s referral points will not count towards Fred’s bonus. ❌ Not eligible John creates multiple wallets to claim referral points. These wallets do not meet eligibility requirements (e.g., no valid .sol purchase). The points from these wallets are removed and do not count toward his bonus. ❌ Not eligible Liveness Check & FAQ If your wallet is eligible, you will still need to pass a liveness check in order to claim $SNS successfully. This requirement helps keep the claiming process fair for real users and makes it harder for bots to take unfair advantage. If you fail the liveness check, you will not be able to claim $SNS. Any unclaimed or unclaimable tokens will return to the Ecosystem Growth pool for future campaigns, partnerships, and programs that benefit the entire community. Q: My wallet is eligible. Can I still claim? If your wallet meets the snapshot criteria, you are eligible. You will be able to claim so long as you successfully pass the liveness check. Anti-Sybil protections are intended to ensure claims are made by genuine participants. Q: What are “anti-Sybil protections”? These include a liveness check and additional measures we have put in place to prevent large-scale abuse and automated claiming. We cannot share all the precautionary measures we are taking as doing so will likely increase the chance of circumvention by bad actors but please rest assured that we are doing our best. Q: Are you changing the rules? No. The snapshot list and eligibility criteria remain exactly as posted. Anti-Sybil protections will apply to the claiming process , not the eligibility list. Q: Why not block multi-wallet abusers now? We share the concern about multi-wallet abusers, but rushing to block wallets isn’t as simple as it sounds. Blunt and broad rules, hastily applied, risk cutting out legitimate users and damaging trust in other ways. Many users in Web3 hold multiple wallets, so the snapshot counted all eligible wallets equally. Changing that after the fact is retroactive and unfair. Our focus now is preventing automated or abusive claims and building detection that nails actual abusers without burning the honest ones. Q: Will the anti-Sybil protections affect future campaigns? We intend these protections to apply to all future SNS activities to keep them fair and fun. Q: What if my claim is blocked in error? Contact support via our Discord server . While protections apply equally to all wallets, we aim to review and resolve any legitimate case quickly and fairly. Previous Overview Next Introduction Last updated 1 year ago Was this helpful?
